serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Tracers with AMP® is a SaaS patient safety platform built to provide healthcare organizations with a single platform for continuous compliance, digital tracing, and rounding. Tracers with AMP® enables users to efficiently collect, analyze and visualize real-time data. Tracers with AMP® provides user-friendly, interactive dashboards and easy-to-build automated reports to help proactively identify risk areas, prioritize improvements, compare key performance indicators, document changes and track progress over time. Users can collect and aggregate data for: The Joint Commission Accreditation and Certification Program Requirements, Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Requirements for Hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals and Ambulatory Surgery Centers, rounding activities related to patient safety, Environment of Care, Infection Prevention, Leadership, Management and many more.  Through Tracers with AMP®, users can: track and enter Plans of Correction, Plans of Action (POA), crosswalk The Joint Commission Standards and Elements of Performance (EPs) to CMS Requirements, download Evidence of Standards Compliance (ESC) and multiple cycles of Requirements for Improvement (RFIs) to analyze findings over time.
